content.comment_body: I've searched online for hours looking for a site where I can download [product_name] instead of buying a CD. My laptops haven't had CD drives for years. Could someone please provide a link where I can purchase a license and download [product_name]? My [article_no] hardware is arriving tomorrow, and I want to get started right away. Thanks!

Hello, Unfortunately, [product_name] is not available for direct download; you can only get the demo version online. The full version is only supplied on DVD under article number [article_no]. [url] Regards,

Really? Why is that? I've already spent several hundred euros on the hardware, and there's still no option for a digital download, just outdated CD format. That's disappointing. Can I transfer the installation from another laptop if I can find someone with a CD drive?

Yes, you can create an ISO file from the purchased DVD and use any free ISO mounting software available online. Alternatively, you can copy the DVD contents to a USB stick and transfer it to your PC. Regards,

Thank you. I guess I'll go buy a USB DVD reader from a local tech store. I'm disappointed by how outdated [company_name] has made this process. Now I have to wait for [product_name] to be physically delivered and ordered.
How do you install a downloaded upgrade for [product_name], whether or not [product_name] is already installed?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated by the absence of a digital download option for [product_name], as it's only distributed on physical DVD. This requirement is seen as outdated and inconvenient, especially since modern devices rarely include CD/DVD drives. The situation causes delays and additional purchases, negatively affecting the setup experience and overall user satisfaction.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily purchase and digitally download [product_name] without needing obsolete hardware or waiting for physical shipping.
